deadlines.label: Bluebonnet Horse Expo
deadlines.when: Sat Oct 3 · Williamson Co. Expo Center, Taylor TX

checklist.text: Send photos of pasture, fencing, shelter and water
Get pre-approval call from the Adoption Coordinator
Email top 3 horses (first choice on only one) by Sept 18, 9 AM
Visit fosters near home before the Expo (Cleveland, Alvin, Dickinson, Huntsville)
Attend Expo Oct 3 — watch classes, test ride with trainer, adopt at half-price fee

horses.name: Noah
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Broke to ride, basic groundwork. Competing in the Non-Pro Under Saddle division with trainer Piper Keenan; also competed in the 2021 Professional division. Seized in a 2019 case, returned to BEHS early 2025.

horses.name: Milkshake
horses.desc: Paint gelding · 11 yrs · 15 hh · bay pinto
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Calm, sweet nature; stands tied, good for the farrier, loves attention. Arrived needing medical treatment, now sound. Professionally evaluated and trained; in the Training Challenge.

horses.name: Canyon
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Broke to ride with basic groundwork. Surrendered to law enforcement; now in the Non-Pro Under Saddle division with trainer Melissa Landry. Biggest horse on the list.

horses.name: Fortuna
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Gentle, willing nature after a neglect seizure. Started by her foster; in the Non-Pro Under Saddle division with Kimberly Shaw. Older, so light trail use.

horses.name: Carmen
horses.desc: Quarter Horse mare · 14–16 yrs · 14.3 hh · sorrel
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Hates arena work, happiest on the trail. Goes English, Western or bareback. Pushy with other horses — best as a single horse or with a firm herd.

horses.name: Arrowhead
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Prefers trail over arena; spooks at loud noises. No known health or lameness issues. Been through several Training Challenges; now with Sophie Fleming.

horses.name: Koozie
horses.fee: Posts in Sept · ½ price at Expo
horses.blurb: Owner-surrendered so he could find the right home. Professionally trained, in the Professional division with Jessica Dziekan.

horses.name: Aria
horses.blurb: Their only 'Ready to Ride' horse. W/T/C, rides trails on the property, loads and stands well. May need chiropractic; swishes tail when uncomfortable under saddle. Small for a grown man.

horses.name: Reynolds
horses.desc: Quarter Horse gelding · 13 yrs · 14.1 hh · bay
horses.blurb: Green: ridden at walk and trot, moves nicely, goes in a snaffle. Good for the farrier, easy in the pasture. A project you could finish yourself.

rescues.name: Bluebonnet Equine Humane Society
rescues.where: Foster-based, statewide Texas + LA/OK/AR border counties. Expo Oct 3 in Taylor, TX.
rescues.process: Application + membership + property photos → adoption coordinator call → email top 3 by Sept 18 → attend Expo, watch classes, test ride, adopt. Fees half price on Expo day. 30-day full refund / 1-year partial refund if it doesn't work out. No selling, leasing or breeding; home visits.

rescues.name: Habitat for Horses
rescues.where: Miracle Ranch, 6060 Habitat for Horses Ln, Alvin, TX. 300+ equines; mostly companion, started, or unstarted.
rescues.process: Free online application → 3 ranch visits for a riding horse (1 for companion) → Coggins → pickup. Requires ½ acre per horse, 12×12 stall or 10.5×10.5 run-in, no barbed wire under 5 acres, yearly vaccines/dental/Coggins. Periodic post-adoption checks. No beginners on riding horses.

rescues.name: Houston Humane Society — Equine
rescues.where: 14700 Almeda Rd, Houston. Listings on My Right Horse; currently companion-only horses (~$250).
rescues.process: Application → team review → meet & greet → facility check (visit or photos) → agreement. Horses come vaccinated, dewormed, dental, farrier, microchipped.

rescues.name: The Pegasus Project
rescues.where: Ben Wheeler, TX (East Texas). Professionally starts every horse that can be ridden.
rescues.process: Call and ask what's coming off training — listings don't show training detail online.

rescues.name: New Vocations — Racehorse Adoption
rescues.where: 82136 Hwy 437, Covington, LA. Off-track Thoroughbreds; e.g. Zack Talkin Smack, 4 yr, 16 hh, $2,500, flat-only.
rescues.process: Standard application; horses are young and green — not trail-ready yet.

rescues.name: Also worth a call
rescues.where: Safe Haven Equine Rescue, Gilmer TX · Humane Society of North Texas ranch, Joshua TX · Texas 4-H Homes for Horses, College Station (youth-trained horses, adopted after the state show).
rescues.process: None publish training levels online; ask directly for anything broke to ride and trail-safe.
